02 / THE SAMPLING DILEMMA
Healthcare often sees
snapshots. Disease lives in the gaps.

Standard episodic clinical visits capture only brief, isolated readings months apart. NHM is a research prototype exploring whether continuous, multi-modal research monitoring can observe more of the picture between those visits -- today via server-side research inference, not on-device, and not yet validated on real wearable hardware.

06 / SERVER-SIDE INFERENCE
Released inference,

server-side today.

The virtual wearable streams to the NHM product API, which calls the released SOFTWARE_SYSTEM_V2 (MODEL_V2_FINAL) over localhost. Nothing runs on a sensor; on-device or edge deployment is not implemented.

07 / PRIVACY-PRESERVING LEARNING
Learn together.
Share less.

Federated learning lets participating clients contribute model updates while raw recordings stay at the client. In this prototype the clients are synthetic research partitions - not hospitals or institutions - and the federation product runtime is not yet enabled.

Under the interface is

a layered system.

A research layering from concept sensor front-end sketches, through server-side CPU inference and a federated-learning research lineage with a SecAgg+ interface reference, to research-only monitoring states. No on-device inference, differential privacy or deployed system is implemented.
